ValidationRule.description: Comments required whenever severity or diagnosis type changed to mention the reason
ValidationRule.errorConditionFormula: AND( OR( ISCHANGED( Severity__c ), ISCHANGED( Diagnosis_Type__c ) ), ISBLANK( Comments__c ) )
ValidationRule.errorMessage: Please provide comments when changing Severity or Diagnosis Type. / गंभीरता या निदान प्रकार बदलते समय टिप्पणी देना आवश्यक है।
